map.和固定/变动成本有关吗？: Does It Relate to Fixed / Variable Costs?
map.复盘季度成本数据，看波动是否收敛，评估降本措施成效。: Review the quarterly cost data to see whether the fluctuation is converging and to assess the effect of the cost reduction measures.
map.对比多条产品线的单位成本，判断成本差异来自普遍水平还是个别异常。: Compare the unit cost of several product lines and judge whether the cost difference comes from the general level or an individual anomaly.

map.数据量少可以吗？: Is a Small Data Set Acceptable?

map.输入各项成本数据（逗号或换行分隔），统计占比、均值与离散度，辅助成本控制与结构优: Enter the cost data (separated by commas or newlines) to compute the shares, the mean, and the dispersion, supporting cost control and structural optimization.
map.页面不区分成本属性，只做数值统计；建议按固定与变动拆分后分别贴入，结论更有指导性: The page does not distinguish cost attributes and only does numerical statistics; it is recommended to split fixed and variable costs and paste them separately, which makes the conclusion more useful.
map.页面直接展示统计结果，可手动复制；如需长期留档建议把原始数据另存备查。: The page shows the statistical results directly and they can be copied manually; for long-term archiving, save the raw data separately.
